content: Salon booking platforms (Fresha, Vagaro, Booksy, Square, Boulevard, Mindbody) converge on table-stakes: service catalog with duration/price, real-time availability calendar, 24/7 online self-booking, automated reminders/confirmations, double-booking prevention. Marketplace/discovery (client acquisition via platform's own directory) is a differentiator specific to multi-tenant SaaS vendors, not relevant to a single-salon site.
